scope: Main phases and projects only; no certifications, manuals, installer skills, external datasets or model weights.
state: Release audit: fixed-revision author MIT content; external resources are links only, no model weights or external datasets mirrored.
notes: Internal project grader and lesson runner source is retained for download, not executed. Curated drawing providers are AST checked for network, storage and dynamic-code capabilities and rendered only in a network-blocked disposable browser during build; deployed diagrams are PNG with explicit static-snapshot captions. Markdown HTML is escaped. Referenced local SVGs are screened for active/external resources. Remote images remain attributed links, never downloaded.

credentialPatternReview.disposition: exact AWS public documentation example access-key ID used in a synthetic redaction test, not a real credential; no blanket exception for other strings/files
